description_en: Migrates an instance across hosts in a dedicated cluster
description_zh: 调用MigrateDBInstance接口迁移专属集群内的RDS实例
kebab_example: aliyun rds migrate-db-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dedicated-host-group-id dhg-4nxxxxxxx --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk5xxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: MigrateDBInstance

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The dedicated cluster ID. You can call the DescribeDedicatedHostGroups operation to query the dedicated cluster ID
parameters.name: dedicated_host_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the host to which you want to migrate the primary instance. You can call the DescribeDedicatedHosts operation to query the host ID
parameters.help_zh: 主实例要迁移的目标主机ID。可调用DescribeDedicatedHosts获取
parameters.name: target_dedicated_host_id_for_master

parameters.help_en: The ID of the host to which you want to migrate the secondary instance. You can call the DescribeDedicatedHosts operation to query the host ID
parameters.help_zh: 备实例要迁移的目标主机ID。可调用DescribeDedicatedHosts获取
parameters.name: target_dedicated_host_id_for_slave

parameters.help_en:
The time when you want the system to start the migration. Valid values:

Immediately: The system immediately starts the migration. This is the default value.
MaintainTime: The system starts the migration during the specified maintenance window.
Specified: The system starts the migration at the specified point in time
parameters.help_zh:
迁移时间。取值：
Immediately：立即切换（默认）
MaintainTime：在运维时间段切换
Specified：指定时间切换
parameters.name: effective_time

parameters.help_en:
The point in time when you want the system to start the migration. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

This parameter must be specified when you set EffectiveTime to Specified
parameters.help_zh: 指定切换的时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 当EffectiveTime=Specified时需要填入本参数
parameters.name: specified_time

parameters.help_en: The zone ID of the logger instance
parameters.name: zone_id_for_log

parameters.help_en: The zone ID of the secondary node
parameters.name: zone_id_for_follower

MigrationId.description_en: The serial number of the task in the migration task queue. When the serial number becomes 0, the system starts the migration
MigrationId.description_zh: 迁移排队序号。当序号为0时，就会进行迁移切换
